records.title: Yardrat training outfit
records.summary: Navy-and-gold tunic, white sleeves and trousers, lavender sash and matching boots.
records.details: Original Yardrat outfit repaired and cleaned at Equipment Services on 20 October after the quarry mission; currently worn.

records.title: Spare Yardrat outfit
records.summary: Complete matching navy, gold and white outfit with lavender sash and boots.
records.details: Made and collected at Equipment Services on 20 October. Still carried under Zero’s arm; not yet stored in Room 214. Ordinary clothing, matching the original.

records.title: Time Patrol communicator pin
records.summary: Small Time Patrol badge pin, normally tucked beneath Zero’s collar.
records.details: The TP emblem pin is the communicator, not a separate decorative badge. Concealed beneath the collar and functional. Used for integrity reports, extraction requests and local messages. Purpose-built Patrol communications remain usable across temporal travel; the original scouter’s disconnected network is separate. Patrol apparel is provided and wearing its insignia is viewed favourably, but it is optional; many Patrollers conceal their communicator inside their own clothing.

records.title: Room 214 access card
records.summary: Issued by Mr. Satan during the first evening’s room visit.
records.details: Opens Room 214. Timeline deployments require separate dispatch approval.

records.title: Travel bag
records.details: Spare clothes, toiletries and ordinary travel essentials, packed from Namek and used during the Yardrat stay. Yamcha retrieved the bag from Bulma’s ship and returned it; Zero put it away in Room 214. The original outfit, repaired scouter and Chronoa’s protected scroll are packed inside.

records.title: Black-and-burgundy outfit
records.summary: Original black-and-burgundy outfit and cape, repaired after Namek.

facts.label: Pieces
facts.value: Wrap-front top, loose trousers, sash, wrist wraps, boots and burgundy cape with gold clasps

records.details: The chamber-exit repairs removed the old arrival tear. Subsequent battle damage was repaired on 22 April after the TL-619 mission, retaining the same style and muscular fit. The cape remains part of the outfit. A clean set of the same design replaced dusty quarry clothing after the mission. Stored in the travel bag after receiving Yardrat clothing. The bag is now in Room 214.

records.title: Recovered red scouter
records.summary: Repaired original scouter, available for readings.

facts.label: Condition
facts.value: Lens, display and mount repaired; original sensor retained

facts.label: Known use
facts.value: Local target acquisition and power readings

facts.label: Network
facts.value: Disconnected from Frieza’s network by temporal transit

records.details: Turles’s ambush broke the scouter; equipment services repaired and returned the same device on 22 April. Two post-fight readings were 5,190; the next evening’s readings were 5,213. Temporal transit persistently scrambles standard scouter networking, not local scans. Return travel, rebooting and this repair do not reconnect it or upload stored recordings. Untouched local scouters still work: Jeice and Burter’s report reached Frieza. The Patrol communicator is separate. Stored in the travel bag in Room 214. Used for the rested checks after Yamcha returned the bag, then put away.

records.title: Chronoa’s seal briefing
records.summary: Written account of the seal, channel and failed Kaioken combination.
records.details: Guru read the briefing before examining Zero and returned it before the Namek training. The protected scroll is inside Zero’s travel bag, now stored in Room 214. Historical reference: the Dark Factor and seal were integrated into Zero’s biology on 6 October; the former seal and channel no longer exist.

records.title: Conton City Dragon Balls
records.summary: Set used for the integration wish; none currently owned.
records.details: All seven TP-RS-647 balls were used on 6 October and returned to the Time Nest vault. No remaining wish, reserved replacement or personal cooldown.
